info.description: Interactive reference for the Portals Partners API. Every request needs the `Authorization: partners <token>` header. You get the key yourself in the Portals mini app: profile menu → Partner API. Plans, rate limits, errors and examples are in the [Partners API guide](/developers/api/).

404.description: Gift not found among your gifts: `GIFT_NOT_FOUND`.

409.description: The gift cannot be bet now: `GIFT_UNAVAILABLE`.

422.description: The bet is rejected. Invalid request body: message without `code`. Arena codes: `GAME_NOT_ACCEPTING_BETS`, `COUNTDOWN_TOO_CLOSE`, `MAX_PLAYERS_REACHED`, `BET_TOO_SMALL`, `BET_TOO_LARGE`, `INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE`, `GIFT_BETS_DISABLED`, `DUPLICATE_GIFT`, `INVALID_AMOUNT`, `INVALID_TEAM`, `USER_TOURNAMENT_BET_LIMIT`.

504.description: The outcome of the bet is unknown: `BET_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN`. The bet may have been placed: check the Arena state before placing it again.

post.description:
Create an offer to buy NFTs from a specific collection. Funds will be frozen until offer is accepted or cancelled
Required fields: collection_id, amount, max_nfts (1..50).
Offers with attributes return 403 while trait offers are disabled (mode read_only or off).

post.description:
Update up to 50 own collection offers in one request. Items are processed sequentially and independently: a failed item does not affect the others (partial success).
Required per item: id, amount (>= 0.5). Optional: max_nfts — remaining NFT slots (1..50, total with already bought must not exceed 50); omitted = keep current slots, no fee. Every slot increase charges the offer fee for the added slots.
Optional expiration_days: 0 makes the offer indefinite, 1 or 7 resets expiration from now, omitted keeps the old expiration.
Balance is checked per item against the remaining balance. Trait offers can be updated only while trait offers are enabled; such items fail individually otherwise.
Returns 200 with per-item results; 422 if the request itself is malformed (empty list, more than 50 items, duplicate ids, invalid amount/max_nfts/expiration_days) — nothing is applied in that case.
